Home About us Contact us Experts in transitions from other providers Fully managed service as standard Competitive management fee 2 types of childcare vouchers Freephone customer care line Personal & fully flexible approach You are here : Fideliti Childcare Vouchers > About Fideliti About Us : The Fideliti Story Fideliti has been actively running Childcare Voucher Schemes since 2005. Fideliti is an ethical family owned company specialising in the provision of childcare vouchers. Our bespoke systems and procedures allow us to offer maximum flexibility and tailored solutions to meet the needs of our clients. Since our inception we have achieved rapid growth and in December 2011,2012 and 2013 we were listed in the Sunday Times Virgin Fast Track 100 companies. Our rapid expansion can be credited to the exceptional levels of customer service, dedicated account management and customer focused approach we offer to our clients. Our client base incorporates a wide range of market sectors across the whole of the UK and our clients ranges from small companies with less than ten employees to large multi-national companies with thousands of employees. Our clients include Councils, Police Forces, NHS Trusts, Universities, Central Government Departments, FTSE 100 companies and many more. Whatever the size of the client, we remain focused on ensuring that excellent customer service is delivered at all times. One of the key benefits in dealing with Fideliti as the provider of childcare vouchers is that we endeavour to reduce the administration burden for our clients. Our standard management fee is based on a fully managed service ensuring that the client’s involvement is minimal and is restricted to payroll deductions and the processing of our monthly invoice. As a business we are constantly monitoring and reviewing the service we offer. We conduct regular customer satisfaction surveys to understand the needs and expectations of our users with regards to our services and business processes. We act on any feedback received and ensure that we are offering the best service available to all of our clients. We take a pro-active approach in our marketing strategy and are regularly reviewing our marketing literature and information. Our aim is to ensure the scheme is easily understood and available to as many employees as possible. Home About us Contact us Employee Overview FAQs Approved Childcare You are here : Covid-19 Faqs - Frequently Asked Questions What Are Your Opening Hours? Our telephone opening times are normally Monday - Friday, 10am – 1pm. Please be aware that these are subject to change at short notice. We do not open at weekends or on Bank Holidays. You can contact us outside of these hours by emailing enquiries@fideliti.co.uk and a member of the team will get back to you. How Do I Change My Childcare Voucher Amount? To change your monthly voucher amount/deduction from salary, you need to login to your Fideliti Account via our website and click on the "Amending My Childcare Voucher Amount" option within the My Account section. The options regarding this will then be shown to you. You are unable to do this via the mobile app. How Do I Cancel My Childcare Vouchers? To cancel your monthly voucher amount/deduction from salary, you need to login to your Fideliti Account via our website and click on the "Cancel My Childcare Vouchers" option within the My Account section. The options regarding this will then be shown to you. You are unable to do this via the mobile app. I'm Unable To Access My Fideliti Account If you are having difficulty accessing your Fideliti Account you are able to request either a reminder of your username or a password reset. Any reminder or password reset emails will be sent to the email address you used to register with Fideliti, unless you have subsequently changed this. Your user name is not your email address. If you are still unable to access your Fideliti Account, please email our Customer Service Team at enquiries@fideliti.co.uk and a member of our team will be able to assist you. How Much Notice Is Required To Make A Change/Cancellation? Under the terms and conditions of the scheme we require one month's notice prior to your date of pay. However, this is also determined by your employer's payroll cut off date. What Is The Minimum Voucher Amount? The minimum voucher amount is £10.00 per month. If I Cancel My Childcare Vouchers Will I Be Able to Re-join The Scheme At A Later Date? If you decide to cancel your childcare vouchers and need to re-join the scheme in the future, you must do so within 52 weeks of your last deduction/voucher being issued. This assumes that you are also staying with the same employer. If you move employer or leave the scheme for 52 weeks or more, you lose your eligibility to re-join.
